name: 16436-decodeheavy-1.5b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1)
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one vLLM engine, one GPU
architecture: dense decoder, Qwen2ForCausalLM, 28 layers, 1.54B params, GQA (12 query / 2 KV heads, head_dim 128), hidden 1536, vocab 151936, 32768 context; served float16, an override of the checkpoint's bfloat16
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 1.0 req/s, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 300 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 16436
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape: 1000 prompt tokens and 100 output tokens with zero variance; EOS is ignored, so all 100 are generated. Prompts are random and mutually distinct.
purpose: A compact 1.5B chat assistant generating short replies to page-length prompts at one request per second on a single GPU.
launch:
# The declared serve command, reproduced.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
dtype: float16
enable-prefix-caching: true
compilation-config: 3
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
